The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the logic for weighted risk assessment is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the judge_reward was lower at 0.67, the core logic for 'hospital-capacity-at-risk-calc' met all functional requirements. Future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions to improve the judge's qualitative score despite the technical success.
